core_connection.text: Adobe's customer support team, which Mia contacts to cancel unwanted Adobe subscriptions and get refunds for automatic renewals and trial conversions.

evidence.quote: Please cancel my Creative Cloud Photography plan
Please cancel the plan without an early termination fee
Please cancel my Creative Cloud Photography plan
My Adobe Stock free trial converted
Thank you for cancelling the plan.

facts.text: This is Adobe's customer support team. Mia is a customer writing to cancel subscriptions and ask for refunds.
In replies to the support agents, Mia addresses them as 'Adobe Customer Care'.
Mia signed up for the Creative Cloud Photography plan in January 2024 for a single project.

evidence.quote: I signed up for this plan in January 2024

facts.text: Mia had not opened Lightroom or Photoshop since March 2024.

evidence.quote: have not opened Lightroom or Photoshop since March 2024

facts.text: The Photography plan renewed automatically on December 20, 2024 for $119.88, and Mia did not get a reminder before it renewed.

evidence.quote: I did not receive a reminder

facts.text: In January 2025 support cancelled the Photography plan and first refunded only $60.00. Mia asked for the remaining $59.88 and for escalation to the billing team.

evidence.quote: Thanks for cancelling the plan and refunding $60.00.
please escalate the request to the billing team

facts.text: The full $119.88 was eventually approved ($60.00 + $59.88), and Mia asked for written confirmation that the plan was fully closed.
Mia's Adobe Stock free trial converted to a paid plan on December 6, 2025, and she was charged $29.99.

evidence.quote: converted to a paid plan on December 6, 2025

facts.text: Mia signed up for the Adobe Stock trial only to download two images, and none of the paid plan's assets were used.

evidence.quote: I signed up for the trial to download two images

facts.text: Support charged a cancellation fee on the Stock plan and waived half of it. Mia asked them to waive the rest and refund the $29.99 charge, pointing out that the trial page did not mention an annual commitment.

evidence.quote: I'm asking for the remaining cancellation fee to be waived as well
the trial page did not say that it would convert to an annual commitment

facts.text: Mia's usual approach: ask for a one-time exception, and escalate (to the billing team or a supervisor) if the first support level cannot approve it.

evidence.quote: please escalate the request to a supervisor

facts.text: Mia always asks support to confirm the cancellation, that there will be no further charges, and the total amount refunded.
